svg.title: Engineering work and current focus
svg.desc: Experience: Newdich Technology. Backend engineering on software built with a product team. Open source: Zudojs. A modular TypeScript framework, alongside other public projects. Project work: 31 case studies. Systems across commerce, data, security, learning and developer tools. Now: Nantty. Founder and lead engineer building a social marketplace. Pre-launch development is ongoing.
